changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwaplov AS SELECT al.key, al.lov_code, al.lov_name, al.lov_description, al.love_custom_code, al.parent_lov, al.auto_select_default, al.default_value_id, al.created_by, al.updated_by, al.deleted_by, al.created_at, al.updated_at, al.deleted_at, al.is_valid FROM public.ap_lov al;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwaplov TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwaplov FROM report_user;
